Maria C.: Hey team — quick sync on the Alpha Preview cohort handoff.
Sam A.: Thanks — account list looks healthy overall, but 2 accounts (Calyx + Boxen) flagged renewal risk if we don't show value within 3 weeks.
Lee S.: What material do they need? onboarding runbook or live demo?
Maria C.: Both. Calyx asked for example prompts and a short run-of-show for the demo. Boxen wants integration checklist + SSO notes.
Jordan O.: I'll own demo run-of-show and coordinate dates. Open slots Wed/Thu PM. @Sam A. can you confirm Calyx POC availability?
Sam A.: pinged POC — waiting. If they can't make Wed/Thu we do recorded demo + live Q&A.
Ashley F.: For feedback loops, recommend 1 survey after demo and a 3-day follow-up touch. I'll prepare a short Google form and a Notion feedback page.
Maria C.: Can we add a small evaluation prompt set for them to run against their data? Lee, can you publish a starter prompt set in the customer repo? repo link: https://internal.redwood/cs/alpha-resources
Lee S.: Yep — posting now. Snippet:
```:
- prompt: "Summarize recent support tickets about billing"
- expected labels: ["billing", "refund", "subscription"]
```
Lee S.: Also adding a QR to the feedback form in the demo slides.
beta-bot: Reminder: enablement kit template v1 uploaded by Jordan O. (link: https://internal.redwood/enablement/kit-alpha)

- Jordan: schedule demos + send calendar invites (due EOD today)
